title: 第7章 你怎么知道我手里没有其他的碧落兰呢第8章 她一个凡人不可能种出碧落兰
slug: 什么你说修真界大佬全都是我弟
content_zh:
“好。”林朔风点头。
甚至没有问夏以苜有没有找到证明清白的方法，便作势要带着夏以苜去找曹宗主。
林朔风本来打算和岳冉解释他与夏以苜的关系。
他们二人要联姻，往后便是一家人，有些事情至少要解释一下，以免误会。
可岳冉对他姐的敌意太大，对他姐那般不尊重，他有些生气，便也懒得解释。
岳冉就这么被直接忽略了，她的脸色已经难看到了极点，心中的怒火几乎要将岳冉点燃。
堂堂元婴期修士竟然完全听一个凡人的安排！林朔风当她是傻子，看不出来他们二人的端倪吗？！
区区凡人，自以为笼络了林朔风的心，便敢如此挑衅她？
可岳冉并没有当场发作，为了一个凡人放下她宗门天骄的体面，未免太丢身份。
便跟在夏以苜和林朔风的身后，与他们一同去找宗主。
她倒是要看看，他们能有什么办法解决碧落兰的事情！
夏以苜和林朔风走在前面，她终于有机会问林朔风和岳冉的事情。
“其实也没有什么，就是宗门联姻，紫云宗要依赖瑶华宗的灵泉水，才能种出来灵植。”
因为魔气污染，如今种植灵植普遍需要灵泉水的浇灌。
“但瑶华宗的灵泉水供不应求，曹宗主便想出了联姻的办法，岳冉是瑶华宗主的女儿，我与她结为道侣，瑶华宗便不会不管紫云宗。”
“嘶。”夏以苜倒吸一口气，“所以，你和岳冉没有感情基础，就是纯联姻？”
“是。”林朔风挤出一个苦笑，“是不是觉得很像你之前爱看的那些狗血豪门总裁小说？”
“这么大一个宗门，为何偏偏选中了你？”她微微蹙眉，当然不愿看到自己弟弟成为联姻的工具。
林朔风叹息一声，“师尊离开多年，紫云宗一直留着我们孤云峰，我也该对宗门做出点贡……”
“停停停。”林朔风话还没说完，便被夏以苜打断。

她眼神逐渐狐疑，“这些话……不会是那什么曹宗主对你说吧？”
“姐，你怎么知道？”林朔风惊讶。
她却没有再说，“行，我知道了。”
林朔风不明所以，但以他姐此刻的状态来看，怕是有人要遭殃了。
林朔风想带她去宗主堂，她却摇了摇头。
“之前当众说要处罚我，如今证明清白，自然也要当着所有人的面。”
所以最终她到达的地点还是之前的那片广场。
接到林朔风传来信息的曹宗主稍后抵达，面上写满了不悦。
刚想问林朔风何必如此大费周章，便看到了缓步走来的岳冉。
当即堆起一个笑容，迎上前去，“岳师侄，你今日怎么过来了，可是来看朔风的？”
转头便看到林朔风身边站着个少女，曹宗主当即变了脸色。
对着林朔风使眼色，让他赶紧离夏以苜远些。
夏以苜挑了挑眉，林朔风半步没动。
“曹宗主，你们宗门难道不打算解释一下吗？”岳冉在曹宗主面前也毫不客气。
瑶华宗的体量比紫云宗大，地位自然更高。
content_en:
"Okay." Lin Shuofeng nodded.
Without even asking Xia Yihuo if he had found a way to prove his innocence, he pretended to take Xia Yihuo to find Sect Master Cao.
Lin Shuofeng originally planned to explain his relationship with Xia Yishu to Yue Ran.
The two of them are going to get married and become a family from now on. Some things must be at least explained to avoid misunderstandings.
But Yue Ran was too hostile to his sister and was so disrespectful to his sister. He was a little angry and didn't bother to explain.
Yue Ran was simply ignored. Her expression turned extremely ugly, and the anger in her heart almost ignited Yue Ran.
The dignified Yuanying Stage monk actually completely obeyed the arrangements of a mortal! Lin Shuofeng thought she was a fool, couldn't he see the clues between the two of them? !
A mere mortal, thinking he had won Lin Shuofeng's heart, dared to provoke her like this?
But Yue Ran didn't break out on the spot. It would be too humiliating for her to let go of her sect's pride for a mortal.
Then he followed Xia Yihuo and Lin Shuofeng and went with them to find the sect leader.
She wanted to see if they could solve Biluolan's problem!
Xia Yishuo and Lin Shuofeng were walking in front, and she finally had the opportunity to ask about Lin Shuofeng and Yue Ran.
"Actually, it's nothing. It's just a marriage between sects. Ziyun Sect has to rely on Yaohua Sect's spiritual spring water to grow spiritual plants."
Because of the pollution caused by demonic energy, planting spiritual plants now generally requires watering from spiritual spring water.
"But the supply of spiritual spring water in the Yaohua Sect exceeds the demand, so Sect Master Cao came up with a marriage plan. Yue Ran is the daughter of the Sect Master Yaohua. If I become a Taoist couple with her, the Yaohua Sect will not ignore the Ziyun Sect."
"Hiss." Xia Yilu took a breath, "So, you and Yue Ran have no emotional basis, it's just a pure marriage?"
"Yes." Lin Shuofeng squeezed out a wry smile, "Doesn't it feel like those bloody wealthy CEO novels you loved to read before?"
"Why did such a large sect choose you?" She frowned slightly, of course she didn't want to see her brother become a tool for marriage.
Lin Shuofeng sighed, "Master has been away for many years, and the Ziyun Sect has kept us at Guyun Peak. I should also make some tribute to the sect..."
"Stop, stop, stop." Before Lin Shuofeng could finish speaking, he was interrupted by Xia Yilu.
Her eyes became suspicious, "These words... couldn't be said to you by that Sect Master Cao, right?"
"Sister, how do you know?" Lin Shuofeng was surprised.
But she didn't say anymore, "Okay, I get it."
Lin Shuofeng didn't know why, but judging from his sister's current state, someone was probably going to suffer.
Lin Shuofeng wanted to take her to the sect leader's hall, but she shook her head.
"I was told that I would be punished in public before, but now that I have been proven innocent, I naturally have to do it in front of everyone."
So the place she finally arrived at was still the same square as before.
Sect Master Cao, who received the message from Lin Shuofeng, arrived later, with displeasure written on his face.
Just when he was about to ask Lin Shuofeng why he went to such trouble, he saw Yue Ran walking slowly towards him.
He immediately put on a smile and stepped forward to greet him, "Senior nephew Yue, why are you here today to see Shuofeng?"
Turning around, he saw a young girl standing next to Lin Shuofeng, and Sect Master Cao's expression immediately changed.
He winked at Lin Shuofeng and told him to stay away from Xia Yilu.
Xia Yishuo raised his eyebrows, but Lin Shuofeng didn't move a step.
"Sect Master Cao, don't your sect plan to explain?" Yue Ran was not polite in front of Sect Master Cao.
Yaohua Sect is larger than Ziyun Sect, so its status is naturally higher.
